Chicken Wrap Recipe
By: Rahul Upadhyay
Published: Wednesday, October 4, 2017 - 12:17am

Ingredients




INGREDIENTS
Rotis: 4
Sliced red and yellow bell pepper: 1/2 cup
Sliced onions: 1/2 cup
Chicken breast sliced: 1 cup
Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce: 2 tablespoons
Salt to taste
A pinch of pepper
Oil: 1 tablespoon
Hung curd: 1 tablespoon
Tandoori masala: 1 teaspoon

Preparation

1 METHOD OF PREPARATION 2 In a bowl, marinate chicken with hung curd, 1 tablespoon Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup, tandoori masala, salt and pepper 3 Heat oil in a pan and cook the chicken until done. Allow it to cool. 4 Now, soften the roti on the pan (Refer to the video for better understanding) 5 Shred the chicken. Take the roti, spread Kissan sweet and spicy sauce on it 6 Layer it with sliced onions, sliced bell peppers and cooked shredded chicken 7 Fold the roti in a wrap. 8 Serve.

About

Chicken Wrap is a tasty comfort food your child will love to eat, the best thing about chicken wrap is you don’t need spoon or table manner, just pick and eat, Chicken Roll Recipe is easy to make and healthy food your child.
The Chicken Wrap in your kid’s tiffin is a refreshing take on a chicken tandoori, incorporating health with taste. Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup is a perfect add-on to marinate the chicken for the wrap. Your kids will love it!
